commonDirection: Use case: stylized-concept. RAIL ARENA / FOUNDRY environment production reference. High-quality production low-poly, broad faceted ivory ceramic shells, graphite structure, muted teal recesses, restrained CYAN service/traversal energy, sparse copper hardware. Amber plus symbols reserved for health. Original competitive sci-fi arena, bright neutral studio lighting, matte/satin materials, no microgreeble noise. Clean well-separated panels, large readable labels, no illegible explanatory paragraphs. Model-building review art, not certified CAD or game screenshot. Keep walking surfaces flush and unobstructed.

images.prompt: Reference sheet for eight structural module families, front side top back underside and small isometric render where practical: 4x4x0.6m floor tile, 4x2x0.6m closure, 4m wall bay, perimeter edge cap, bridge support beam, 4m upper landing panel, 10x4m wing balcony construction, and large RAMP ASSEMBLY study. The ramp side profile is strictly rising in ONE direction: 6.5m horizontal incline from0m to2m high, then3m flat at2m, then6.5m horizontal incline continuing to4m. Total16m long and4m wide, side exit at the flat midpoint. Never an arch or roof. Show three bold segment dimensions 6.5 / 3 / 6.5 and four height nodes0 / 2 / 2 / 4. Floor seams flush, optional beams beneath surfaces, no railings across required exits. Backing ribs consistent with shell. Align silhouettes across views, no assembled arena fantasy layout.

Nine clearly separated cover families on neutral grey board in 3x3 cards. Each card front side top and back/underside pair; same object geometry per card. All dimensions Width x Depth x Height in metres. A low wing cover2x1x1.2. B underpass pier1.6x4x3.4. C bridge screen1.5x2.4x2.6. D lane elbow2x2x2.6. E cross-lane elbow2.4x2.8x2.6. F corner screen2x2x2.6 (same base model as D, label alternate mounting). G spawn lip3.2x1.6x2.6. H narrow spawn screen1.2x2.8x2.6. I gate baffle1x2x2.6. Opaque full-height plates, sparse recessed cyan strips, ivory/graphite/teal broad planes. No see-through holes in sight blockers. Orange thin simplified collision outline on two examples. No people or weapon. Label dimensions as targets. Keep decorative bevels within footprint.

Dedicated jump pad modeling and states reference sheet. One 2m diameter round/octagonal pad with .35m recessed body, TOP surface FLUSH at arena floor. Orthographic TOP BOTTOM FRONT BACK LEFT RIGHT, one exploded construction view and three-quarter beauty view. Broad graphite walking top, segmented ivory rim, teal internal frame, small directional cyan chevrons. No protruding spikes or rails. Four storyboard states IDLE CONTACT LAUNCH FADE, short restrained upward cyan impulse, no opaque energy column. Separate simple geometry diagram for2m trigger and3x3m clear landing square, no false game map. Small side section showing floor-level top with body underneath. Construction consistency across all views.

Dedicated portal pair reference sheet: same housing used for A and B, 2.4m wide .8m deep2.8m high, clear field1.4m wide2.2m high starts at FLOOR LEVEL, no raised sill. FRONT BACK LEFT RIGHT TOP BOTTOM orthographic plus isometric and exploded rim/core/base. OPAQUE cyan energy FRONT, solid graphite closed back, no view of another location, no transparent middle or tunnel. Clear inward-facing floor arrows and A/B identifiers, ivory shell graphite frame teal recesses copper mounts. State strip IDLE DEPART ARRIVE BLOCKED with crossed-aperture symbol for blocked; small field ripple when absorbing incoming energy. Front-entry plane diagram and free exit capsule diagram using neutral silhouette, no weapons, no projectile tutorial. Keep silhouette stable in all states, modest glow.

Dedicated arena health object and pedestal reference sheet. Consistent AMBER plus-sign collectible hovering above a low ivory/graphite mount0.8x0.8x.25m, plus object .35m across by .5m high. All six orthographic directions, isometric, underside mounting, separate marker and pedestal, material detail strip. Clear available/collected/returning state thumbnails; plus vanishes when collected while pedestal dims. Nonblocking presentation, avoid implying physical barrier or armor/ammo pickup. Amber plus sign is not a medical real-world brand. Broad stylized faceted low-poly, moderate emissive brightness. Include tiny ground-plane inset showing mount inset into floor so no toe snag.

Environment dressing modeling reference sheet, two sections. Upper: recessed ventilation housing, flat conduit bay, flush inset deck light; each front side top back underside and isometric. Lower: distant WEST graphite segmented turbine silhouette and EAST ivory split-fin silhouette, matching broad scale and comparable visual mass, each front/back/side and three-quarter; not traversable. Also NORTH gate header with THREE BARS and SOUTH gate header with TWO CHEVRONS, large readable icons and text. Broad simple shapes, no dangling cables, no giant moving fan blades or hazards. Show inset mount sections for vent/conduit/light. Cyan only tiny service accents. No amber decorative light strips. Neutral background.

World scene and lighting reference for floating Rail Arena Foundry. Wide top landscape: restrained faceted industrial floating islands in pale blue/ivory cloud sea, reduced background contrast, original graphite and ivory distant citadels. Southwest soft sun35-degree elevation, gentle skylight, no strong glare toward camera. Lower panels clear NORTH EAST SOUTH WEST sky horizon studies, ZENITH and NADIR swatches, one simple lighting-direction diagram and material spheres ceramic graphite teal rock. Foreground playable deck snippets remain visually quiet. No new playable routes, no giant bridge between distant islands, no characters, vehicles or giant emissive distractions. Deliberate low-poly geometry with clean high-quality light. Label SKY MOOD REFERENCE / NOT A SEAMLESS CUBEMAP. No dense photo-real paneling.

Use case: stylized-concept. RAIL ARENA / FOUNDRY environment production reference. High-quality production low-poly, broad faceted ivory ceramic shells, graphite structure, muted teal recesses, restrained CYAN service/traversal energy, sparse copper hardware. Amber plus symbols reserved for health. Original competitive sci-fi arena, bright neutral studio lighting, matte/satin materials, no microgreeble noise. Clean well-separated panels, large readable labels, no illegible explanatory paragraphs. Model-building review art, not certified CAD or game screenshot. Keep walking surfaces flush and unobstructed. Use the supplied greybox overview as the STRICT GEOMETRY AND CAMERA REFERENCE, not an edit target that may be freely redesigned. Produce a full-frame environment art-over of THIS exact arena: preserve the footprint, every platform opening, four ramp profiles and flat turnouts, all cover placements, upper bridge and lower loop. Add only matching surface materials, flush panel seams, light edge chamfers and original sci-fi dressing within existing solid volumes. Do not add towers on the arena, bridges across holes, new railings, pickups, paths or walls. Cyan blocks are pad/landing review markers, not eight pads: show exactly FOUR pad devices at outer lower start positions, keep four upper landing areas flat and clear with subtle chevrons. Purple rectangles are exactly TWO opaque cyan portal devices, fronts cyan, closed backs graphite. Orange cubes become exactly THREE amber health markers. Pink spawn tiles should become subtle non-emissive floor markings, not glowing pickups. Tiny green drop bars remain clear safe drop edges. Ivory upper structures and teal/graphite lower floor. Pale atmospheric cloud world and distant non-playable silhouettes only outside the arena. No humans, HUD, weapon, text or decorative cables across lanes. Keep camera and silhouette as close to the measured source as possible. Review concept artwork, not a game screenshot.

Edit ONLY card B UNDERPASS PIER in this Rail Arena cover reference sheet. The current card is incorrectly an open I-beam, which allows sightlines through its recesses. Replace BOTH front and back drawings in card B with a broad FULLY SOLID OPAQUE RECTANGULAR PIER, width1.6m depth4.0m height3.4m. Fill the entire central column face with graphite/ivory panels; no open bay, no gaps, no transparent negative spaces, no I-beam or thin stalk. Maintain clean broad faceted low-poly style and existing dimensions/labels. It is a full sight-blocking rectangular mass like a thick solid structural wall. Keep all other eight cards, their dimensions and all layout unchanged.
